_about: Public-domain Charles Abel Heurtley (1806-1895), Margaret Professor of Divinity at Oxford, for the Word Hoard: Justification (his Bampton Lectures of 1845), Parochial Sermons Preached in a Village Church, A History of the Earlier Formularies of Faith, and On Faith and the Creed, his translations of patristic treatises. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-24 by lane A, round 135 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

heurtley-justification: Justification. Eight sermons preached before the University of Oxford, in the year MDCCCXLV, at the lecture founded by the late Canon Bampton (Oxford : J. H. Parker, 1846)
heurtley-parochial-sermons: Parochial sermons preached in a village church (catalogued 1849)
heurtley-baptism-manual: A manual of instruction for adult candidates for holy baptism (catalogued 1852)
heurtley-formularies: A history of the earlier formularies of faith of the Western and Eastern churches, to which is added an exposition of the Athanasian Creed, being the substance of a course of lectures (London, James Parker and co., 1892)
heurtley-faith-creed: On faith and the creed : dogmatic teaching of the church of the fourth and fifth centuries (catalogued 1886)

_excluded.heurtley-latin: Harmonia Symbolica and De Fide et Symbolo are Latin collections of creeds and patristic texts
_excluded.heurtley-dups: the other scans of Justification and On Faith and the Creed
